get.summary: Get the signed-in user's home feed

200.description: Busy rooms, the next movie night and activity (up to eight latest ratings, approved reviews, public list updates, shared watchlist additions and watches from active followed members). Profile and section privacy are checked on every request. Each activity has a source-prefixed string id, kind, user, nullable tmdb_id, media_type and created_at. Ratings/reviews include nullable rating, nullable excerpt and has_spoilers; spoiler text and hidden ratings are omitted. List activity includes list {id, title}.

The current user's profile and preferences. `has_password` is false while an account made by Google, GitHub or Discord sign-in has not chosen its own password yet. `pending_email` is the address waiting for its confirmation link (PUT /api/me/email), or null. `pending_email_awaiting_current` is true while the change still has to be approved from the current address (accounts without a password, or whose first password was set in Settings and not yet proven by a password reset or a completed email change); the new address has not been mailed yet. `deletion_by_email` is true when DELETE /api/me mails a confirmation link instead of asking for the password (no password of its own, or a first one set in Settings and not yet proven), and `deletion_pending` is true while such a link is still valid (60 minutes, not used or cancelled).

patch.description: Any of `name`, `username`, `location`, `bio` and `profile_visibility`. `email` is accepted only when it equals the current address (forms send the whole profile); a different one is rejected with 422, because changing it goes through PUT /api/me/email.

422.description: Validation failed, or `email` differs from the current address.

delete.description: When the account's password proves ownership (`deletion_by_email: false` in GET /api/me), `password` is required: the account, its stored avatar and everything it owns are deleted, the session cookies are cleared and the address gets a notice. Otherwise (no password of its own, or a first password set in Settings without a current one and not proven since) `password` is ignored: a pending deletion is stored and a signed confirmation link (GET /api/me/delete/confirm/{id}/{hash}, valid 60 minutes) and a cancel link are mailed to the account's current address; nothing is deleted yet and `deletion_pending` turns true. A new request voids the links of an earlier one. Rate limited to 5 per minute and 10 per hour per account.

password.description: Required when GET /api/me has `deletion_by_email: false`; ignored otherwise.

200.description: Account deleted (`{"message": "Account deleted."}`); the session cookies are cleared.

202.description: Confirmation link mailed to the account's address (`message`, `deletion_pending: true`); nothing deleted yet.

422.description: The password is missing or wrong (on `password`).

patch.description: Any of `favorite_genres`, `privacy`, `integrations` and `notifications`; each group only changes the switches sent. `notifications` has one switch per notification type (`follow`, `follow_accepted`, `room_invite`, `room_joined`, `room_deleted`, `new_messages`, `mention`, `night_invite`, `night_rsvp`, `night_vote`, `night_update`, `review_helpful`), all on by default; a switched-off type is never sent. put.summary: Ask to change the sign-in email
put.description: Stores the address as `pending_email`; `user.email` and `email_verified_at` do not change until the change is confirmed. With a password of its own (`has_password: true`) the account must send `current_password`; the new address then gets a signed confirmation link (valid 60 minutes) and the current address a notice, with the new one partly hidden, carrying a signed cancel link (GET /api/me/email/cancel/{id}/{hash}). Without one, or when the password was first set in Settings without a current one and the inbox has not been proven since (a password reset through the emailed link or a completed email change), only the current address is mailed: a signed approval link (GET /api/me/email/authorize/{id}/{hash}, valid 60 minutes) plus the cancel link, and the new address gets its confirmation link once that is opened (`pending_email_awaiting_current` is true until then). Every link is bound to this request and the current password hash: a new request (even back to an earlier address), a cancellation, or a password change or reset voids them. Rate limited to 3 per minute and 10 per hour per account (shared with resend).

email.description: Must differ from the current address and not belong to another account.

current_password.description: Required when GET /api/me has `has_password: true`; omitted by accounts made by social sign-in that never chose a password.

200.description: The account (same shape as GET /api/me) with `pending_email` set and `pending_email_awaiting_current` true when the current address has to approve first.

422.description: Validation failed (invalid, unchanged or taken email), or the current password is missing or wrong (on `current_password`).

delete.description: Clears `pending_email` and its approval state, so links already sent stop working. Nothing happens when there is none. Changing or resetting the password does the same.

post.description: Mails a fresh 60-minute link for the stage the change is waiting for: the approval link to the current address while `pending_email_awaiting_current` is true, otherwise the confirmation link to `pending_email`. Shares the rate limit of PUT /api/me/email.

get.summary: Approve an email change from the current address (signed link)
get.description: Mailed to the current address when the account's password proves nothing (no password of its own, or a first password set in Settings and not yet proven) and it asks to change its email; no login is required. A valid link records the approval, mails the confirmation link to the new address and redirects to FRONTEND_URL/edit-profile?email_change=check-new-inbox (opening it again, or twice at once, mails the new address only once). Replaced, cancelled, tampered or unknown links, and links made before a password was set, redirect with `invalid`, correctly signed expired ones (60 minutes) with `expired`, and `taken` when another account started using the new address meanwhile (the pending change is then dropped). Rate limited to 20 requests per minute per IP, shared with the other email-change links.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User id.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 (keyed with APP_KEY) over the link's purpose, the pending address, the request's nonce and the current password hash.

parameters.name: expires
parameters.description: Unix timestamp at which the link expires (part of the signed URL).

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: URL signature generated by the server.

302.description: Redirect to FRONTEND_URL/edit-profile with email_change=check-new-inbox, invalid, expired or taken.

get.summary: Confirm a new email address (signed link)
get.description: Opened from the email sent by PUT /api/me/email; no login is required. A valid link makes `pending_email` the sign-in email, marks it verified, revokes every refresh token of the account (all devices sign in again once their access token expires) and tells the previous address, then redirects to FRONTEND_URL/edit-profile?email_change=success. Replaced, cancelled, tampered or unknown links, links made before a password change or reset, and links opened before the current address approved the change (accounts without a password) redirect with `invalid`, correctly signed expired ones with `expired`, and `taken` when another account started using the address meanwhile (the pending change is then dropped). Rate limited to 20 requests per minute per IP.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User id.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 (keyed with APP_KEY) over the link's purpose, the pending address, the request's nonce and the current password hash.

parameters.name: expires

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: URL signature generated by the server.

302.description: Redirect to FRONTEND_URL/edit-profile with email_change=success, invalid, expired or taken.

get.summary: Cancel an email change from the current address (signed link)
get.description: The "this wasn't me" link in the notice or approval email sent to the current address; no login is required. A valid link drops that pending change (its other links stop working) and redirects to FRONTEND_URL/edit-profile?email_change=cancelled. It only cancels the request it was mailed for: after a newer request, a cancellation, a completed change or a password change it redirects with `invalid`, as tampered links do; correctly signed expired ones (7 days) redirect with `expired`. Rate limited to 20 requests per minute per IP, shared with the other email-change links.
